author: Jotbot
body:
Dear FunkyStudios,

What the hell happened to CTH. It was my favorite gamemode until everybody stopped playing. In order to get it going again and not have this wasted gamemode, I believe we should change up the kits and completely redo the whole thing. What I mean is that we should make about five maps and release them all at once, and then have a CTH tournament. The winners get like $25 in store credit. Kind of like the Nebula thing (which never happened) but with only like 8 different teams. Or just anything to get this wonderful gamemode up and running again. Everyone who reads this, please leave your thoughts on the situation below.

Sincerely, Jotbot

PS: I cant use tab for some reason

replies.body: It isn't as dead as you think. There has been at least 1-2 full rotations of CTH every day for the past 2 weeks.
